_comment: Pricing settings for the FUSE NEON quote skill. Edit the numbers here; nothing else needs to change.
_pricing_mode_help: markup = add a percentage on top of cost (cost 100 at 50% -> 150). margin = percentage of the final sale price (cost 100 at 50% margin -> 200).
_percent_help: product applies to neon price, uv print, and any other product line. shipping applies to shipping and freight lines.
footnote_1: Price in CAD. Taxes, delivery and installation to be confirmed.
footnote_2: Final artwork, backing finish, illumination colour and mounting details require approval before production.
footer_text: Electrical components and applicable certification to be confirmed.
